title: docs(design): plugin-distribution names esbuild, as os plugin build bundles

Fixes #27700

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` 两处把打包工具写成 `tsup` 的句子,改为 esbuild(树形注释一处,§5 第 1 步一处)。
- 为什么改:`os plugin build` 实际用 esbuild 打包入口到 `dist/index.mjs`,设计说明却指引读者去用 `tsup`。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档、不进任何包的发布内容,无运行时风险;回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看:`docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` 第 164 行起的 §5 第 1 步新句子是否与你对构建流程的理解一致。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `git grep -n -w tsup -- docs/design/plugin-distribution.md`,预期没有任何输出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Two sentences in `docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` named `tsup`; `os plugin build` bundles with esbuild. Each replacement is written from what `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/build.ts` does, not by swapping the word:

- Tree comment (`.osplugin` layout, L113): "pre-built ESM bundle (tsup)" becomes "pre-built ESM bundle (esbuild → dist/index.mjs)". The build writes the single `dist/index.mjs` (`outfile` and the staged archive entry).
- §5 step 1 (L164): "run `tsup` (externalize `@objectstack/*`)" becomes "esbuild-bundle the entry to `dist/index.mjs` (externalize `@objectstack/*`, inline every other dependency)". In the code `external: ['@objectstack/*']` is the only external, so every other dependency is inlined; this agrees with §4.3 "Bundled only".

Only those two places are edited. The ADR-0025 half of the original card is #27684 (triage re-scope), and `docs/adr/**` is untouched.
